cases.id: set seeds the first key into an empty document
set inserts a second key using '=', no spaces
deleteKey removes the only entry, leaving an empty file
cases.note: Deleting down to empty round-trips back through the same from-empty insert path a from-scratch `set` would use.

cases.id: deleteKey and renameKey on a repeated key take every spelling [1]
cases.note: dotenv reads a key written more than once as one entry, the last spelling's value at the first's place. A delete or rename takes every spelling (`spelledAgain`); one that took the first left the key reading on.
cases.source:
A=1
B=2
# lead
export A=3
A=4 # last

expect.source:
Z=1
B=2
# lead
export Z=3
Z=4 # last

cases.id: deleteKey and renameKey on a repeated key take every spelling [2]
cases.note: Zig error DuplicateKey. A rename to a name the file already holds is refused, as before.

cases.id: an entry appended after an `export` entry starts at column 0
cases.note: The entry's span starts at its key, past `export `; a new sibling takes the line's indent, not the key's column (see `indentAt`).

cases.id: replacing an empty value keeps a blank before its comment [1]
cases.note: `A= #c` is an empty `A`; written straight against the `#`, `42#c` would read as the value.

cases.id: replacing an empty value keeps a blank before its comment [2]

cases.note: The Zig test also reads the comment back (`getLeadingComment`, `getTrailingComment`), which a fixture does not carry: the edits are here, the read is not.
